note: Draft day plan for the Oct 15-21 2026 trip, Vogel State Park base camp. Each stop reuses an existing point/overnight id from map/data/*.json where one exists (lat/lng pulled from that entry at build time); stops without an existing id carry their own lat/lng and a coord_source. This is a planning layer, toggle-able in the map as 'Itinerary'.

days.label: Thu Oct 15 — Arrive, DeSoto Falls / Frogtown Creek

stops.note: Yahoola Creek Park — most gold-storied creek in the district

days.label: Sat Oct 17 — Cooper Creek Recreation Area (north side, away from Gold Rush Days crowds)

stops.note: Deer season opens today — blaze orange required. Dahlonega's Gold Rush Days festival is downtown; stay north at Cooper Creek to avoid the crowds.

days.label: Sun Oct 18 — GA-348 loop: Tesnatee Gap, Upper Chattahoochee FS-44, Dukes Creek Falls

stops.note: Upper Chattahoochee River / FS Road 44 corridor reach, stay below Mark Trail Wilderness boundary
Dukes Creek Falls Recreation Area, NF side only — do not cross into Smithgall Woods State Park

days.label: Mon Oct 19 — Hike in: Three Forks / Noontootla Creek (overnight)

stops.note: Hike in and camp, primary overnight route. Backup: Dockery Lake Trail.

days.label: Tue Oct 20 — Overnight at Three Forks / Noontootla Creek

stops.note: Second night, pan Noontootla Creek at the Three Forks confluence. Backup: Dockery Lake Trail campsite ~3.0 mi.
